name: Naive framework
description: The venture development framework: record schemas, routes, checks, the CLI and MCP server, term engine and Lean proofs. Works offline with no account.
job: Keep a venture as checkable records and show the decision that needs a person

features.name: Create a venture
features.job: npx create-venture or naive new scaffolds a venture

features.name: Decision docket
features.job: Rank the decisions that need a person

features.name: The gate
features.job: Hold agent writes of escalated classes as drafts

features.name: Provenance
features.job: Record who wrote each record, from what

features.name: Phases and gates
features.job: Five phases, each with a gate and exit evidence

features.name: MCP server
features.job: Any MCP client reads and writes the venture

features.name: Term engine and Lean
features.job: Admit terms as checked properties with Lean theorems

features.name: Publish lint
features.job: Check public text for leaks, marks and claims

features.name: Offline sync
features.job: Sync a working copy with a hosted store
